title: What’s new in managing Apple devices
description: Learn about the latest management capabilities for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. Discover how you can streamline the setup experience with enhancements to automated device enrollment and a new return-to-service option for iOS and iPadOS devices. We’ll share how to use your identity provider in even more places on macOS and show you how Apple Configurator can help automate tasks.

resources.title: Shortcuts User Guide for Mac
resources.description: A shortcut is a quick way to get one or more tasks done with your apps. The Shortcuts app lets you create your own shortcuts with multiple steps.

resources.title: Apple Configurator User Guide for Mac
resources.description: Learn how to use Apple Configurator to create and install configuration profiles on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV.

resources.title: Support - Apple Platform Deployment
resources.description: Apple devices integrate hardware, software, apps, and services to let you manage your deployment projects easily. Get the control and flexibility you want by using Apple School Manager or Apple Business Manager and your chosen mobile device management solution.
